tasks.required_evidence: Fresh checkout, exact commit, environment, original install attempts, elapsed time, warnings, failures, and dependency inventory.
Repository and component versions, maturity, and historical support, each with a public locator.
Original command, output, exit code, source and output byte hashes, and comparison with the frozen expected output.
All three selected derived records must be rejected. Preserve complete issues and explain every returned error code from public documentation.
A public-locator-based account of every invariant listed in protocol Task 5, including contradictions or unresolved ambiguities.
Non-mutating plan, source hashes before and after, and an explanation of why automatic migration is prohibited.
Input byte hashes, original comparison, repeated output, and comparison with the frozen expected output. Synthetic vectors supply no human reliability evidence.
A public-locator-based explanation of all excluded functions listed in protocol Task 8.
Every apparent dependency on private knowledge, with original observations and all coordinator exchanges, including none encountered when that is the auditor's actual observation.
Human-supplied eligibility declarations, signed disposition, all results and unresolved findings; schema validation alone cannot establish audit acceptance.

interpretation_boundary: This candidate catalog defines proposed implementation checks. It does not record a performed audit, human inter-rater reliability, institutional effectiveness, or permission to release.
